final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'No status') AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No status')), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS baseline_avg FROM status_averages), kept AS (SELECT status, avg_modindex FROM status_averages WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT baseline_avg FROM baseline)), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT kept.status, kept.avg_modindex, kept.avg_modindex - baseline.baseline_avg AS above_baseline, kept.avg_modindex - kept_mean.mean_kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept CROSS JOIN baseline CROSS JOIN kept_mean
